stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class; exact counts). IU's Common Data Set viewer (crimsoncatalog.iu.edu/cds) requires an IU login, so no Common Data Set was read; GPA, international and residency splits are not shown. College Navigator for fall 2024 shows 2,035 applicants and 67% admitted (exact count not published there); undergraduate enrollment and the 15:1 student-faculty ratio are fall 2024. IU East reports no campus housing to IPEDS.
